name: astro-project-site-repo
description: Monorepo: the astro-project-site package, the template's own website (site/) and the starter that `project-site init` copies (starters/default/).
author: Pavel Pascari

scripts.check: npm run check -w astro-project-site && npm run check -w site && npm run check -w project-site-starter
scripts.build: npm run check -w astro-project-site && npm run build -w site && npm run build -w project-site-starter
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:check -w site && npm run docs:check -w project-site-starter
scripts.test:a11y: node scripts/check-html.mjs site/dist starters/default/dist --skip apps --lang en --dir ltr
